int_name: N BROAD ST & CECIL B MOORE AVE

result.summary: This intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and signalized control in an institutional/commercial setting. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distance and lack of a median refuge increase exposure for the high volume of pedestrians visible.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cover a wide expanse of roadway without a central refuge, increasing exposure time to moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway across the zebra markings

hazards.name: High pedestrian volume
hazards.description: Large groups of pedestrians crossing simultaneously can lead to crowding and slower clearing of the intersection during signal cycles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection equipped with marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and well-maintained sidewalks. However, the significant crossing distance across multiple lanes of traffic increases pedestrian exposure and risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway exposes pedestrians to traffic for a prolonged duration without a midpoint refuge.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and increase the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with high-visibility zebra crosswalks and a central refuge island. While the presence of sidewalks, street lighting, and a transit stop supports walkability, the significant crossing distance and exposure to multiple lanes of traffic present inherent risks.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes, increasing their time in the conflict zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the image.

hazards.name: Multi-lane Traffic Exposure
hazards.description: Four through lanes of traffic increase the complexity of the crossing and the potential for high-speed vehicle movements.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes of the street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Implement a leading pedestrian interval to allow pedestrians to enter the crosswalk before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Raised Intersection
interventions.description: Consider a raised intersection or raised crosswalks to physically slow vehicle traffic at the crossing point.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and wide sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the crossing distance across the multi-lane roadway lacks a median refuge island.
